name: Aire de Bourron-Marlotte (Fontainebleau)
legality_notes: ONF Authorized bivouac zone. Sunset-to-sunrise strictly enforced. No fires permitted.

name: Aire de la Faisanderie (Fontainebleau)
legality_notes: Official ONF zone near the forest office. Safe for single night stays. 19:00 - 09:00.

name: Aire de l'Hippodrome de la Solle
legality_notes: Large authorized perimeter. Low patrol frequency at night. No fires or gas stoves allowed.

name: Etang de la Tour (Rambouillet)
legality_notes: Designated area near the GR1. Patrols active on weekends. Leave no trace mandatory.

name: Bois de l'Etang d'Or (Rambouillet)
legality_notes: Tolerance zone near established markers. 200m rule from water bodies applies.

name: PNR Vexin (Roche-Guyon)
legality_notes: Strictly outside nature reserves and agricultural plots. 100m distance from public roads.

name: Haute Vallée de Chevreuse (Senlisse)
legality_notes: Authorized only within GR11 corridor transit. No wild camping (multiple nights).

name: Crêt de la Perdrix (Pilat)
legality_notes: High altitude tolerance. Extreme wind exposure. 19:00 - 09:00 rules strictly apply.

name: Crêt de l'Oeillon (Pilat)
legality_notes: Summit bivouac allowed. No stoves during high fire-risk months (July-August).

name: La Jasserie (Pilat)
legality_notes: Managed bivouac area nearby. Proximity to GR7 makes it a legal transit stop.

name: Plateau de la Danse (Gorges de la Loire)
legality_notes: Tolerance outside core nature reserves. Avoid lighting any fire source.

name: Crêt de l'Airelle (Monts du Lyonnais)
legality_notes: Rural forest tolerance. Stay on public domain paths. Stealth is highly recommended.

name: Cabane de Pré Peyret (Vercors)
legality_notes: Legal bivouac zone within the Reserve des Hauts Plateaux. Mandatory 200m from water.

name: Plaine de la Queyrie (Vercors)
legality_notes: High aesthetic value. Thermal drone patrols active. Use cold-survival protocols.

name: Col de la Croix Perrin (Vercors)
legality_notes: Transit bivouac permitted. Avoid blocking forest management tracks.

name: Dent de Crolles Base (Chartreuse)
legality_notes: Bivouac permitted above 1500m. Pack out all waste. No fires allowed.

name: Prairie de la Folletière (Chartreuse)
legality_notes: Permitted outside active grazing seasons. Respect temporary local fencing.

name: Col du Coq (Chartreuse)
legality_notes: Sensitive zone. Must bivouac at least 500m away from the Col infrastructure.

name: Mont Mezenc
legality_notes: Tolerance on public slopes. High wind. Prohibited near sensitive peat bogs.

name: Sommet du Semnoz
legality_notes: Tolerance for sunset-sunrise stops. No fire or stoves during summer alerts.

name: PNR Landes de Gascogne (Hostens)
legality_notes: Rural forest tolerance. High fire risk. Check 2026 fire-ban status weekly.

name: Vallée du Ciron (Bommes)
legality_notes: Permitted near river transit. Strictly no fire near Sauternais vines.

name: Lac de Carcans-Hourtin (East)
legality_notes: Stealth required. Strictly 19:00 - 08:30. Avoid dune protection areas.

name: Delta de l'Eyre (Le Teich)
legality_notes: Strict timing enforced. High biodiversity zone. No pets permitted in certain corridors.

name: Sauternais Forest (Budos)
legality_notes: Low-risk forest tracks. Respect private vineyard boundaries. No fire.
